# Data
Load libraries
```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, # spatial
               here, 
               tidyverse, 
               rio, # for importing
               table1, # make table1
               lubridate,
               ncf, #correlation
               xtable, # export table1
               fuzzyjoin, # joining with some inexact
               spdep, # regression spatial
               tmap, # spatial maps
               sjlabelled, # table 1 labels for sf
               geepack, # for regression
               lme4,
               terra,
               raster,
               exactextractr,
               MuMIn, # calculate icc
               iccCounts,
               performance
               )
```

Read in data
```{r}
# ## Population of Mérida + Kanasín (old)
yuc_pop <- read.csv("data/SINAVE_Data/RESAGEBURB2020 - 31 Yucatán.csv")

merida_pop <- read.csv("data/yuc_pop/yuc_pop_all.csv") %>% # all of yucatan
  filter(MUN == 50 | MUN == 41 | MUN == 101) # only metro merida

## Mérida + Kanasín shapefile from INEGI (eem - Block Polygons)
merida_block_sf <- st_read(dsn = here("31_yucatan_2020/conjunto_de_datos"),
                    layer = "31m")
merida_block_sf <- merida_block_sf %>% 
  filter(CVE_MUN == "041" | CVE_MUN == "050" | CVE_MUN == "100")

## Mérida + Kanasín shapefile from INEGI (eea - Basic Urban Geostatistical Areas)
merida_cluster_sf <- st_read(dsn = here("31_yucatan_2020/conjunto_de_datos"),
                    layer = "31a")
merida_cluster_sf <- merida_cluster_sf %>% 
  filter(CVE_MUN == "041" | CVE_MUN == "050")

## SINAVE case data
sinave_all_cases <- here::here("data", "SINAVE_Data", 
                       "datos_abiertos_dengue_061223.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()

## Cases Shapefile
cases_sf <- st_read(dsn = here("data"), 
                 layer = "TIRS_SINAVE_22_23")

## Cases by TIRS block (not a shapefile, will add this info onto the shapefile)
cases_tirs_info <- read_csv("data/TIRS_SINAVE_combined22_23_blockID.csv")


## TIRS Clusters Shapefile
clusters_sf <- st_read(dsn = here("data"),
                    layer = "Cluster final 2021 actualizado")

## entomological data
ento <- here::here("data", "TIRS_database_entom_summ.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()

# make sure all sf files have the same coordinates 
merida_cluster_sf <- st_transform(merida_cluster_sf, st_crs(merida_block_sf))
cases_sf <- st_transform(cases_sf, st_crs(merida_block_sf))
clusters_sf <- st_transform(clusters_sf, st_crs(merida_block_sf))
```

## data formatting for model
```{r}
seven <- cases_tirs_info %>% 
  head(7) %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID, MZTIRS, CLUSTER, Week_onset, Week_onset)
v <- c(rep(-1, 9), rep(-1, 3), 1)
neg_vax <- as.data.frame(matrix(v, nrow = 7, ncol = length(v), byrow = TRUE))
seven <- cbind(seven, neg_vax)
write.table(seven, file = "seven.txt", sep = " ", row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE)

inf_time <- seven$Week_onset
inf_times <- matrix(inf_time, nrow = 100, ncol = length(inf_time), 
                    byrow = TRUE)
write.table(inf_times, file = "inf_times.txt", sep = " ", row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE)

# attendance
house_attend <- c(0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 1)
house_attend <- matrix(house_attend, nrow = 7, ncol = 50)
write.table(house_attend, file = "house_attend.txt", sep = " ", row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE)

attend_school <- c(1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1)
attend_school <- matrix(attend_school, nrow = 7, ncol = 50)
write.table(attend_school, file = "attend_school.txt", sep = " ", row.names = FALSE,
```

## Some Cleaning
### update shapefiles 
to include extra data
```{r}
# Population Data
## add CVEGEO to population dataset
merida_pop <- merida_pop %>%
  mutate(CVE_ENT = as.character(ENTIDAD),
         CVE_MUN = paste0("0", MUN),
         CVE_LOC = paste0("000", LOC),
         CVE_AGEB = AGEB,
         CVE_MZA = ifelse(nchar(as.character(merida_pop$MZA)) == 3,
                          as.character(MZA),
                          ifelse(nchar(as.character(merida_pop$MZA)) == 2,
                                 paste0("0", MZA), paste0("00", MZA))),
         CVEGEO = paste0(CVE_ENT, CVE_MUN, CVE_LOC, CVE_AGEB, CVE_MZA))

## now add this population data into the shapefile to get a shapefile with pop
##   data
merida_block_sf <- merida_block_sf %>% 
  right_join(merida_pop, by = c("CVEGEO", "CVE_ENT", "CVE_MUN",
                                     "CVE_LOC", "CVE_AGEB", "CVE_MZA"))

# Case Data
```

### dengue 2023 cases only
```{r}
# select cases of all the CONFIRMED 2023 dengue cases
sinave_all_dengue <- sinave_all_cases %>% 
  # only want data for Mérida + Kanasín (050, 041 MUNICIPO_RES)
  filter(MUNICIPIO_RES == 50 | MUNICIPIO_RES == 41 | MUNICIPIO_RES == 101) %>% 
  # change symptom onset date to match cases dataset (i.e., weeks since 
  #  start of ABD season)
  mutate(Week_onset = ymd(FECHA_SIGN_SINTOMAS),
         Week_onset = epiweek(Week_onset),
         Year = year(FECHA_SIGN_SINTOMAS)) %>%
  relocate(c(FECHA_SIGN_SINTOMAS, Week_onset), .before = ID_REGISTRO) %>% 
  filter(ESTATUS_CASO == 2) %>%  # 1 likely; 2 confirmed; 3 discarded
  mutate(age_grp = as.factor(ifelse(EDAD_ANOS < 18, "Child", "Adult")))

# all DENV cases from the TIRS trial area
denv_cases_sf <- cases_sf %>% #674 cases
  filter((str_detect(Diagnosis, "DENV") | str_detect(Diagnosis, "DENGUE"))
         & Year == 2023) %>% # only dengue, only 2023 
  mutate(Age = as.numeric(Age),
         age_grp = as.factor(ifelse(Age < 18, "Child", "Adult")),
         TIRS = factor(TIRS, levels = c(0, 1), 
                       labels = c("Control", "TIRS Intervention")))
# only adult cases (< 18); 268 cases
denv_adult_cases_sf <- denv_cases_sf %>%
  filter(as.numeric(Age) >= 18)
# child dengue cases; 345 cases
denv_kid_cases_sf <- denv_cases_sf %>% 
  filter(as.numeric(Age) < 18)
```

Number of dengue cases in 2023: `r nrow(denv_cases_sf)`
Number of adult dengue cases in 2023: `r nrow(denv_adult_cases_sf)` 
Number of child dengue cases in 2023: `r nrow(denv_kid_cases_sf)`

# Tables
Demographic info on the dengue cases
## (city) table1 for confirmed dengue cases in the entire city
```{r}
# sinave_all_dengue is all confirmed dengue cases in the city

## formatting
sinave_all_dengue$SEXO <- 
  factor(sinave_all_dengue$SEXO, levels = c(1, 2),
         labels = c("Female", "Male"))
sinave_all_dengue$SEXO <- setLabel(sinave_all_dengue$SEXO, "Sex")
sinave_all_dengue$EDAD_ANOS <- set_label(sinave_all_dengue$EDAD_ANOS, "Age")
sinave_all_dengue$Week_onset <- set_label(sinave_all_dengue$Week_onset, 
                                          "Week of Symptom Onset*")
footnote <- "*Week of the year"

## table
table1_city <- table1(~ EDAD_ANOS + SEXO + Week_onset | age_grp, data = sinave_all_dengue,
       render.continuous = c(.= "Mean (SD)", .="Median [Min, Max]",
                             .= "Median (Q1, Q3)"),
       footnote = footnote)
table1_city <- as.data.frame(table1_city)

## print table
print(xtable(table1_city, type = "latex"), file = "table1_city.tex")
```

## (tirs) table1 for confirmed dengue cases
```{r}
# denv_cases_sf is all the confirmed dengue cases within the tirs trial area

## formatting
denv_cases_sf$Age <- as.numeric(denv_cases_sf$Age)
denv_cases_sf$Age <- set_label(denv_cases_sf$Age, "Age")
denv_cases_sf$TIRS <- set_label(denv_cases_sf$TIRS, "Trial Arm")
denv_cases_sf$Week_onset <- set_label(denv_cases_sf$Week_onset, 
                                      "Week of Symptom Onset*")

# some ages are missing (in the age_grp variable)
denv_cases_na <- drop_na(denv_cases_sf, age_grp)

## table
table1_tirs <- table1(~ Age + Week_onset + TIRS | age_grp, data = denv_cases_na,
       render.continuous = c(.= "Mean (SD)", .="Median [Min, Max]",
                             .= "Median (Q1, Q3)"),
       footnote = footnote,
       render.missing = NULL)
table1_tirs <- as.data.frame(table1_tirs)

## print table
print(xtable(table1_tirs, type = "latex"), file = "table1_tirs.tex")
```

## proportions
```{r}
# add population info to clusters_sf
clusters_sf <- st_intersection(merida_block_sf, clusters_sf)

# Populations of each cluster + block
cluster_population <- clusters_sf %>% 
  group_by(CLUSTER) %>% 
  summarize(Cluster_Population = sum(POBTOT))
block_population <- clusters_sf %>% 
  group_by(CLUSTER, MZTIRS) %>% 
  summarize(Block_Population = sum(POBTOT))
```

Comparing proportion of cases within the study area vs the rest of the city?
```{r}
# All confirmed cases in Mérida caught by MOH / total population of Mérida
# sinave_all_dengue is all confirmed dengue cases in the city
merida_block_sf <- merida_block_sf %>% 
  filter(AGEB != "0000") %>% 
  filter(NOM_LOC != "Total AGEB urbana")

totals <- merida_pop %>% 
  filter(merida_pop$LOC == 0)

nrow(sinave_all_dengue) / sum(totals$POBTOT)

# adults in city
sum(as.numeric(totals$P_18YMAS))
# children in city
sum(totals$POBTOT) - sum(as.numeric(totals$P_18YMAS))

# trial area
# num cases in trial / total population of trial area
# denv_cases_sf is all the confirmed dengue cases within the tirs trial area
nrow(denv_cases_sf) / sum(clusters_sf$POBTOT)
sum(as.numeric(clusters_sf$P_18YMAS), na.rm = TRUE)
```
Number of dengue cases in city: `r nrow(sinave_all_dengue)`
Population of the city: `r sum(totals$POBTOT)`
Number of dengue cases in trial area: `r nrow(denv_cases_sf) `
Population of the trial area: `r sum(clusters_sf$POBTOT)`

## population
```{r}
merida_block_sf$P_18YMAS <- as.numeric(merida_block_sf$P_18YMAS)

# calculate adult population
clusters_sf$P_18YMAS <- as.numeric(clusters_sf$P_18YMAS)
cluster_adult_population <- clusters_sf %>% 
  group_by(CLUSTER, trial_arm) %>% 
  summarize(Cluster_Adult_Population = sum(P_18YMAS, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()

# calculate kid population
cluster_kid_population <- clusters_sf %>% 
  group_by(CLUSTER, trial_arm) %>% 
  summarize(Cluster_Kid_Population = sum(POBTOT) - 
              sum(P_18YMAS, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()

by_arm <- cluster_adult_population %>% 
  left_join(cluster_kid_population, by = c("CLUSTER", "trial_arm")) %>% 
  group_by(trial_arm) %>% 
  summarize(adult_pop = sum(Cluster_Adult_Population),
            kid_pop = sum(Cluster_Kid_Population))
```
Population of the city: `r sum(merida_block_sf$POBTOT)`
Population of adults in the city: `r sum(merida_block_sf$P_18YMAS, na.rm = TRUE)`
Population of kids in the city: `r sum(merida_block_sf$POBTOT) - sum(merida_block_sf$P_18YMAS, na.rm = TRUE)`

Population of the trial area: `r sum(clusters_sf$POBTOT)`
Population of adults in the trial area: `r sum(cluster_adult_population$Cluster_Adult_Population)`
Population of kids in the trial area: `r sum(cluster_kid_population$Cluster_Kid_Population)`

## dengue cases and mosquitoes
```{r}
# mosquito counts by cluster
mosq_counts <- ento %>% 
  group_by(id_cluster) %>% 
  summarize(ae_fem_total = sum(`Sum of ae_fem`))
mosq_counts <- mosq_counts[-1,]
mosq_counts$id_cluster <- as.numeric(mosq_counts$id_cluster)

# cluster trial arm
cluster_assignment <- clusters_sf %>% 
  group_by(CLUSTER) %>% 
  summarize(trial_arm = round(mean(TIRS), 0)) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()

# bind mosquito counts and trial arm
cluster_assignment$CLUSTER <- as.numeric(cluster_assignment$CLUSTER)
mosq_counts <- mosq_counts %>% 
  left_join(cluster_assignment, by = c("id_cluster" = "CLUSTER"))

# denv_cases_sf is all the confirmed dengue cases within the tirs trial area

## all cases (kids and adults) within each cluster
case_counts_per_cluster_all <- st_join(denv_cases_sf, clusters_sf, join = st_within) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  count(CLUSTER.x) %>% 
  rename(CLUSTER = CLUSTER.x,
         num_denv_cases = n)

# denv_cases_sf is all the confirmed dengue cases within the tirs trial area
# case_counts_per_cluster_all is all cases (kids and adults) within each cluster

# cluster_population is all people in a cluster,
#   respectively
cluster_population <- cluster_population %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()

## add the population to cluster shapefile
cluster_population$CLUSTER <- as.numeric(cluster_population$CLUSTER)
block_population$CLUSTER <- as.numeric(block_population$CLUSTER)
cases_by_trial_arm <- case_counts_per_cluster_all %>% 
  left_join(cluster_population, by = "CLUSTER") %>% 
  left_join(mosq_counts, by = c("CLUSTER" = "id_cluster")) %>% 
  mutate(rate_cluster = (num_denv_cases / Cluster_Population) * 1000)


## formatting
cases_by_trial_arm$num_denv_cases <- setLabel(cases_by_trial_arm$num_denv_cases, "No. DENV Cases in Cluster")
cases_by_trial_arm$Cluster_Population <- setLabel(cases_by_trial_arm$Cluster_Population, "Population of Cluster")
cases_by_trial_arm$rate_cluster <- setLabel(cases_by_trial_arm$rate_cluster, "Cases per 1,000 People in A Cluster")
cases_by_trial_arm$ae_fem_total <- set_label(cases_by_trial_arm$ae_fem_total, "Total Adult Female <i>Aedes Agypti</i> per Cluster")
cases_by_trial_arm$trial_arm <- 
  factor(cases_by_trial_arm$trial_arm, levels = c(0, 1),
         labels = c("Control", "TIRS Intervention"))
cases_by_trial_arm$trial_arm <- setLabel(cases_by_trial_arm$trial_arm, "Trial Arm")



table1_mosquitoes <- as.data.frame(table1(~ num_denv_cases + Cluster_Population 
                                          + rate_cluster + ae_fem_total | 
                                            trial_arm, 
                                          data = cases_by_trial_arm, 
                                          render.continuous = c(.= "Mean (SD)", 
                                                                .="Median [Min, Max]",
                                                                .= "Median (Q1, Q3)")))

## print table
print(xtable(table1_mosquitoes, type = "latex"), file = "table1_mosquitoes.tex",
      include.rownames=FALSE)
```


# Figures
## stacked bar plot
```{r}
# denv_cases_sf is all the confirmed dengue cases within the tirs trial area

ggplot(denv_cases_na, aes(x = TIRS,fill = age_grp)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack") +
  labs(title = "Dengue cases in 2023 among adults and children, by trial arm",
       x = "Trial Arm",
       y = "Number of cases",
       fill = "Age group") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Adult" = "#DC3220", "Child" = "#005AB5"))
ggsave("denv_tirs_cases_stacked_bar.pdf")
```

## line graph adult and child denv cases within trial area
```{r}
# denv_cases_sf is all the confirmed dengue cases within the tirs trial area
## case counts
# All dengue 2023 cases, by age group
denv_adult_counts <- denv_adult_cases_sf %>% 
  count(Week_onset) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()
denv_kid_counts <- denv_kid_cases_sf %>% 
  count(Week_onset) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()

## plot
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = denv_adult_counts,
           aes(x = Week_onset, y = n, color = "Adult")) + 
  geom_line(data = denv_kid_counts,
           aes(x = Week_onset, y = n, color = "Child")) +
  labs(x = "Week of Symptom Onset",
       y = "Number of Cases",
       fill = "Location",
       title = "Dengue Cases for Adults and Children") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 53, by = 2)) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Adult" = "#DC3220", "Child" = "#005AB5"),
                     name = "Age Group")
ggsave("adult_children_line.pdf")
```

## line graph but rates instead of cases
```{r}
# change to rates
## i'm assuming the denominator stays the same over time?
## looking at those in the trial area
## divide by population of adults/kids respectively
denv_adult_rates <- denv_adult_counts %>%
  mutate(rate = (n/sum(cluster_adult_population$Cluster_Adult_Population))*100000)
denv_kid_rates <- denv_kid_counts %>%
  mutate(rate = (n/sum(cluster_kid_population$Cluster_Kid_Population))*100000)

## plot
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = denv_adult_rates,
           aes(x = Week_onset, y = rate, color = "Adult")) + 
  geom_line(data = denv_kid_rates,
           aes(x = Week_onset, y = rate, color = "Child")) +
  labs(x = "Week of Symptom Onset",
       y = "Cases per 100,000 people",
       fill = "Location",
       title = "Rate of Dengue Cases for Adults and Children within the TIRS Trial Area") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 53, by = 2)) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Adult" = "#DC3220", "Child" = "#005AB5"),
                     name = "Age Group")
ggsave("adult_children_line_rates.pdf")
```

# Maps
## (cluster) heatmap for number of cases
```{r}
## add the case counts to cluster shapefile
clusters_sf$CLUSTER <- as.numeric(clusters_sf$CLUSTER)
clusters_cases <- clusters_sf %>% 
  left_join(case_counts_per_cluster_all, by = "CLUSTER")

# plot
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = merida_cluster_sf, fill = "white", linewidth = 0.05) +
  geom_sf(data = clusters_cases, aes(fill = num_denv_cases, 
                                     color = num_denv_cases), 
          linewidth = 0.01) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#deebf7",
    high = "#041c3a",
    name = "Cases") +
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "#deebf7",
    high = "#041c3a",
    guide = "none") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(st_bbox(clusters_sf)$xmin, st_bbox(clusters_sf)$xmax), ## zooom in on cluster area
           ylim = c(st_bbox(clusters_sf)$ymin, st_bbox(clusters_sf)$ymax), 
           expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Heatmap of number of case counts per cluster")
ggsave("heatmap_case_counts_cluster_monochrome.pdf", height = 3)
```

## (cluster) heatmap for cases rate
```{r}
# have cluster_population now we want block_population
block_population <- block_population %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  mutate(IDMZA = paste0(as.character(CLUSTER), as.character(MZTIRS)))
block_population$IDMZA <- as.numeric(block_population$IDMZA)

## add the population to cluster shapefile
clusters_rate <- clusters_cases %>% 
  left_join(cluster_population, by = "CLUSTER") %>% 
  left_join(block_population, by = c("IDMZA", "MZTIRS", "CLUSTER")) %>% 
  mutate(rate_cluster = (num_denv_cases/Cluster_Population) * 1000)

# rate by cluster
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = merida_cluster_sf, fill = "white", linewidth = 0.05) +
  geom_sf(data = clusters_rate, aes(fill = rate_cluster, color = rate_cluster),
          linewidth = 0.05) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#deebf7",
    high = "#041c3a",
    name = "Cases per 1,000 people") +
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "#deebf7",
    high = "#041c3a",
    guide = "none") +
  # scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Cases per 1000 people") +
  # scale_color_viridis_c(guide = "none") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(st_bbox(clusters_sf)$xmin, st_bbox(clusters_sf)$xmax), 
           ylim = c(st_bbox(clusters_sf)$ymin, st_bbox(clusters_sf)$ymax), 
           expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Heatmap of Cases per 1,000 People")
ggsave("heatmap_case_rates_cluster.pdf", height = 3)
```

```{r}
# dataset for the model
## number of cases per block/cluster
reg_dat_orig <- denv_cases_sf %>% 
  count(CLUSTER, MZTIRS, name = "num_cases_total") %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()
adult_cases <- denv_adult_cases_sf %>% 
  count(CLUSTER, MZTIRS, name = "num_cases_adult") %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()
child_cases <- denv_kid_cases_sf %>% 
  count(CLUSTER, MZTIRS, name = "num_cases_kids") %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()

  group_by(CLUSTER, MZTIRS) %>% 
  summarize(trial_arm = mean(trial_arm)) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()

  right_join(trial_arm, by = c("CLUSTER", "MZTIRS")) %>% 
  left_join(adult_cases, by = c("CLUSTER", "MZTIRS")) %>%

         num_cases_adult = ifelse(is.na(num_cases_adult), 0, num_cases_adult),
```

```{r}
dat_adult <- data.frame(dengue_case = c(),
                      trial_arm = c(),
                      cluster = c(),
                      block = c(),
                      age_group = c())
for (row in 1:nrow(reg_dat)) {
  num_cases_adult = reg_dat$num_cases_adult[row]
  noncases_adult = reg_dat$adult_pop[row] - reg_dat$num_cases_adult[row]
  df_temp = data.frame(dengue_case = rep(1, num_cases_adult),
                       cluster = rep(reg_dat$CLUSTER[row],num_cases_adult),
                       block = rep(reg_dat$MZTIRS[row],num_cases_adult),
                       age_group = rep(1,num_cases_adult),
                       trial_arm = rep(reg_dat$trial_arm[row],num_cases_adult))
  dat_adult = rbind(dat_adult,df_temp)
  df_temp = data.frame(dengue_case = rep(0, noncases_adult),
                       cluster = rep(reg_dat$CLUSTER[row],noncases_adult),
                       block = rep(reg_dat$MZTIRS[row],noncases_adult),
                       age_group = rep(1,noncases_adult),
                       trial_arm = rep(reg_dat$trial_arm[row],noncases_adult))
  dat_adult = rbind(dat_adult,df_temp)
}

dat_kids <- data.frame(dengue_case = c(),
                      trial_arm = c(),
                      cluster = c(),
                      block = c(),
                      age_group = c())
for (row in 1:nrow(reg_dat)) {
  num_cases_kids = reg_dat$num_cases_kids[row]
  noncases_kids = reg_dat$child_pop[row] - reg_dat$num_cases_kids[row]
  df_temp = data.frame(dengue_case = rep(1, num_cases_kids),
                       cluster = rep(reg_dat$CLUSTER[row],num_cases_kids),
                       block = rep(reg_dat$MZTIRS[row],num_cases_kids),
                       age_group = rep(0,num_cases_kids),
                       trial_arm = rep(reg_dat$trial_arm[row],num_cases_kids))
  dat_kids = rbind(dat_kids,df_temp)
  df_temp = data.frame(dengue_case = rep(0, noncases_kids),
                       cluster = rep(reg_dat$CLUSTER[row],noncases_kids),
                       block = rep(reg_dat$MZTIRS[row],noncases_kids),
                       age_group = rep(0,noncases_kids),
                       trial_arm = rep(reg_dat$trial_arm[row],noncases_kids))
  dat_kids = rbind(dat_kids,df_temp)
}

dat_total <- rbind(dat_adult, dat_kids)
```

ICC function
```{r}
find_icc_logistic <- function(fit){
  # finding R^2 and ICC
  ## variance of fixed effects
  var_fe <- var(getME(fit,'X') %*% fixef(fit))
  ## variance of block and cluster (how do i know this is the variance of the random effects?)
  ##    isn't 'theta' the RE parameter estimates ?
  var_blk <- unname((getME(fit, 'theta')[1])^2)
  var_clus <- unname(getME(fit, 'theta')[2])^2
  ## total variance
  var_ttl <- var_fe + var_blk + var_clus + pi^2/3 #var of distribution for binomial, logit link
  
  ## R^2
  ### R^2_m is marginal R^2; proportion of total variance explained by fixed effects
  r2_fixed <- var_fe / var_ttl
  ### also calculate variance for block and cluster
  r2_blk <- var_blk / var_ttl
  r2_clus <- var_clus / var_ttl
  ### proportion of variance explained by both fixed and random effects
  r2_c <- (var_fe + var_blk + var_clus) / var_ttl
  
  ## ICC
  icc <- (var_blk + var_clus) / var_ttl # with fixed effects
  icc_adj <- (var_blk + var_clus) / (var_blk + var_clus + pi^2/3)
  
  c(
    r2_fixed = r2_fixed,
    r2_block = r2_blk,
    r2_cluster = r2_clus,
    r2_conditional = r2_c,
    icc_adjusted = icc_adj
  )
}
```

```{r}
var_ttl_a <- var_fe_a + var_blk_a + var_clus_a + pi^2/3 #var of distribution for binomial, logit link

r2_fixed_a <- var_fe_a / var_ttl_a

r2_blk_a <- var_blk_a / var_ttl_a
r2_clus_a <- var_clus_a / var_ttl_a

r2_c_a <- (var_fe_a + var_blk_a + var_clus_a) / var_ttl_a

icc_a <- (var_blk_a + var_clus_a) / var_ttl_a # with 
icc_adj_a <- (var_blk_a + var_clus_a) / (var_blk_a + var_clus_a + pi^2/3)
```

# Poisson Mixed Effects

ICC function (poisson distribution)
```{r}
find_icc_pois <- function(fit, intercept_only) {
  var_fe <- var(getME(fit,'X') %*% fixef(fit))
  var_blk <- unname((getME(fit, 'theta')[1])^2)
  var_clus <- unname(getME(fit, 'theta')[2])^2
  # find latent variance
  var_tau <- unname((getME(intercept_only, 'theta')[1])^2) + 
    unname(getME(intercept_only, 'theta')[2])^2
  beta0 <- getME(intercept_only, 'beta')[1]
  lambda <- exp(beta0 + 0.5 * var_tau)
  var_dis <- log(1 + 1/lambda)
  var_ttl <- var_fe + var_blk + var_clus + var_dis
  
  r2_fixed <- var_fe / var_ttl
  r2_blk <- var_blk / var_ttl
  r2_clus <- var_clus / var_ttl
  ### proportion of variance explained by both fixed and random effects
  r2_c <- (var_fe + var_blk + var_clus) / var_ttl
  ## ICC
  icc <- (var_blk + var_clus) / var_ttl # with fixed effects
  icc_adj <- (var_blk + var_clus) / (var_blk + var_clus + var_dis)
  
  c(
    r2_fixed = r2_fixed,
    r2_block = r2_blk,
    r2_cluster = r2_clus,
    r2_conditional = r2_c,
    icc_adjusted = icc_adj
  )
}
```

## cohort children
```{r}
cohort_cases <- denv_cases_sf %>%
  filter(Source == "TIRS")
add <- cohort_cases %>% 
  count(CLUSTER, name = "tirs_cases") %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()
trial_kids <- cluster_assignment %>% 
  left_join(add, by = c("CLUSTER")) %>% 
  mutate(tirs_cases = ifelse(is.na(tirs_cases), 0, 
                             tirs_cases))

pois_trial <- glmer(tirs_cases ~ trial_arm + (1 | CLUSTER),
             family = "poisson", 
             data = trial_kids)
pois_triali <- glmer(tirs_cases ~ 1 + (1 | CLUSTER),
             family = "poisson", 
             data = trial_kids)
summary(pois_triali)
```
